correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md, D_X is the (r-1)-skeleton on n point vertices, hence its r-flagification is a simplex. For D_Y on the r-subsets, minimal Helly obstruction with all r-fold intersections nonempty has exactly r+1 members A_i=T\{x_i}; an additional r-subset meeting all relevant pairs of T would duplicate one A_i. Thus F_r(D_Y) attaches exactly one r-simplex for each |T|=r+1. The standard vertex-star simplex cover of D_Y has nerve skel_(r-1) Delta^(n-1), and its restriction to each attaching boundary has nerve boundary Delta_T; the natural compatible nerve equivalences preserve attaching maps. The pushout is skel_r Delta^(n-1); acyclic simplex matching gives integral wedge of binom(n-1,r+1) S^r, for every r>=2,n>=r+2. Direct combinatorial small-case checks confirmed four sample exceptional-face counts, but no finite check is substituted for the integral homotopy argument.
